## Measured results

- `make gate` printed `gate: PASS` both times. Attempt 1 was 802 s. Attempt 2, after the document
  edits, re-ran only names and test (89 s).
- `make dist`: `dist_check: 42/43` (D31) and `published_check: 24/25` (P20). Only those two rows
  fail.
- Stand-in-key Distribution: `dist_check: 43/43`, `published_check: 25/25`,
  `dist_check_mutants: 36/36`.
- Archive line, run locally ad hoc: ARCHIVE SUCCEEDED. In the archived (stripped) binary,
  `nm -j | grep -c _svt_av1_enc_init_handle` is **0** (2021 symbols; Distribution has 89275 and
  the symbol once). `published_check` scores **25/25** with `--version 0.2.999 --build 999`. The
  archived `Acknowledgements.txt` is byte-identical to the Distribution build's.
- Two generator runs over the same Release build gave byte-identical files (`cmp`).

## Deviations from the spec, and why

- **Line cap.** `acknowledgements.py` imports its nine stdlib modules on one line
  (`# noqa: E401`), and the selftest is written densely. This keeps the file at 399 lines,
  under the ≤400 the spec requires.
- **Names the interface did not list.**
  - `acknowledgements.py` has `PATCHED = {"tiny-skia": "spec §11 PR-13"}`, so only a patched path
    crate gets "(patched, …)". It also has `LIBRARY_LICENCES`, the encoders' licence expressions,
    because a Pin has no licence field and its entries must stay 2-tuples.
  - `dist_check.py` has `CARGO_ROOTS`, `BUN_LOCK`, `FONTS`, `SPARKLE_VERSION` and
    `sparkle_version()` beside the interface's readers.
- **Missing codec texts.** The generator has no dedicated check for a missing
  `build/codecs/licenses/` text. Reading the file raises an OSError naming the path, which `main`
  reports as `error: …`, exit 1.
- **Bun mismatch outside Distribution.** It is a `--- note ---` text inside the bun entry plus a
  `warning:` line on stderr.
- **D42/D43 with no Fonts folder.** These rows require no `Fonts/` folder: a bundle without one
  (the mutants' skeletons) needs zero fonts. This is how the spec words it ("each `*.ttf` in the
  bundle's Fonts/"), and it keeps `skeleton` an empty-set pass.
- **Tarballs.** The encoder tarballs were copied from `~/devel/framejob/build/codecs-downloads/`
  into this worktree's `build/codecs-downloads/` rather than fetched. They are SHA-256-checked
  either way.

1	# Spec: release items owed before the next publish (#376 acknowledgements, the codecs' published_check rows, the build/codecs Actions cache)
2	
3	## Goal
4	Every build carries `Contents/Resources/Acknowledgements.txt`, generated from the lockfiles and pinned sources each build, checked by dist_check D42/D43 and published_check P25. published_check also gains the encoders' rows P22–P24. P22 reads each encoder's own string bytes, which survive the archive's strip, and P23/P24 are D39/D41. The publish workflow restores `build/codecs` under `build_codecs.py`'s own key, computed under the "Build Codecs" step's PATH, and saves it only when the folder's stamp carries that key. setup-bun pins Bun to the version whose licence is vendored.
5	
6	## Files
7	- `designs/spec/11-decisions/publishing.md` — append PUB-10, PUB-11, PUB-12 (text in Approach 1) BEFORE any code.
8	- `designs/spec/11-decisions/codec-export.md` — CX-5 gets "**Amended by PUB-10**: SVT-AV1's `vector.c` notice is installed as `vector.c-LICENSE`."
9	- `designs/spec/11-decisions/README.md` — PUB-10..12 rows; CX-5 row "— amended by PUB-10"; `publishing.md` row "PUB-1..PUB-12" with the new summary; both Lines cells = `wc -l`.
10	- `designs/spec/README.md` — the `11-decisions/` cell's total (`wc -l` of the folder, README included).
11	- `tools/codecs/build_codecs.py` — `vector.c` excerpt licence entry, `leading_comment()`, `--print-key`, selftest rows E0/E1.
12	- `tools/codecs/PROVENANCE.md` — SVT-AV1's shipped-texts line adds `vector.c-LICENSE` (MIT, Peter Goldsborough, excerpted from the pinned source).
13	- `tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py` — NEW, the generator (≤400 lines, stdlib only, Python 3.9).
14	- `tools/licenses/bun/LICENSE.txt` — NEW, Bun's `LICENSE.md` verbatim at tag `bun-v<BUN_LICENSE_VERSION>`.
15	- `tools/licenses/spdx/MIT.txt` — NEW, the SPDX MIT text with its `<year> <copyright holders>` line removed.
16	- `tools/licenses/PROVENANCE.md` — NEW: each vendored text's URL, tag, SHA-256, fetch date; how to re-vendor Bun's.
17	- `project.yml` — new post-build step "Write Acknowledgements" between "Build MCP Proxy" and "Write Agent Catalog".
18	- `Makefile` — `test` runs `python3 tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py --selftest` after `build_codecs.py --selftest`; comment lines for it and for `dist`'s D42/D43.
19	- `tools/proof/gate.py` — `"tools/licenses"` in `STEP_INPUTS["app"]`; selftest class row `("M8", "tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py", {"names", "test", "app"})`; docstring.
20	- `tools/proof/dist_check.py` — readers below (the acknowledgements readers, and `CODEC_STRINGS` + `codec_strings()`), rows D42/D43, `TOTAL = 43`, docstring.
21	- `tools/proof/dist_check_mutants.py` — skeletons copy `Acknowledgements.txt`; two cases; 36 cases; docstring.
22	- `tools/proof/published_check.py` — P22–P25, `TOTAL = 25`, docstring (P22 says why it is not D37's `nm`).
23	- `.github/workflows/publish.yml` — "Read the pins" step, setup-bun's `bun-version`, cache restore before Archive, stamp check and save after it; header comment.
24	- `docs/developing.md` — `make test` row, layout `tools/licenses/`, "Publishing a release": the acknowledgements, the cache and its stamp check, the Bun pin, what only a real run shows.
25	- `tools/proof/README.md` — V0 section (D42/D43, 43 rows, expected scores), A4 mutant table (two cases, 36/36), the gate section's app inputs and M8, the Publishing section (P22–P25, scores, the local archive measurement, the cache record, measured results).
26	
27	## Interfaces
28	`Acknowledgements.txt` (UTF-8, deterministic, byte-identical for identical inputs; no timestamp):
29	```
30	Frame Job — third-party software notices
31	Generated at build time by tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py; do not edit.
32	<one paragraph: Frame Job is Apache-2.0; it includes the software below>
33	
34	== <kind> <name> <version> ==            # kind ∈ crate npm runtime framework library model font
35	Licence: <expression as the package declares it>
36	Source: <crates.io | npm | vendored at <repo path> (patched, spec §11 PR-13) | URL>
37	--- <file label> ---
38	<full text verbatim>                      # or: (identical to <kind> <name> <version>'s <label>, above)
39	```
40	Order: crates by (name, version), npm by name, `runtime bun`, `framework sparkle`, `library` in `PINS` order, `model silero-vad`, fonts by stem. Font version = `head.fontRevision` to 3 decimals; model version = the `tag \`vX\`` in `app/Resources/Models/PROVENANCE.md`; Sparkle version = `SourcePackages/workspace-state.json`'s resolved `sparkle` version.
41	
42	`tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py`:
43	```
44	python3 tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py --out PATH [--strict-bun] [--sparkle-license PATH]
45	python3 tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py --print-bun-version
46	python3 tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py --selftest | --mutant dev-edges|nested-unchecked|bun-unchecked
47	FIRST_PARTY = ("framejob-core", "graphic", "framejob-mcp"); CARGO_ROOTS = ("core", "mcp-proxy")
48	TARGET = "aarch64-apple-darwin"; BUN_LICENSE_VERSION = "<bun --version on this machine; 1.3.6 at spec time>"
49	LICENCE_PREFIXES = ("LICENSE", "LICENCE", "COPYING", "NOTICE", "UNLICENSE")   # case-insensitive
50	NESTED = {("rquickjs-sys", "quickjs/LICENSE"): True, ("rquickjs-sys", "vendor/wasi-libc/NOTICE.md"): False,
51	          ("fontdb", "tests/fonts/LICENSE.txt"): False, ("@anthropic-ai/sdk", "src/internal/qs/LICENSE.md"): True}
52	class Entry(NamedTuple): kind: str; name: str; version: str; licence: str; source: str; texts: tuple  # ((label, text), …)
53	class Failed(RuntimeError)
54	def cargo_packages(metadata: dict) -> list            # package dicts reachable from resolve.root over non-dev edges (normal AND build), FIRST_PARTY removed
55	def npm_packages(lock_text: str) -> list              # [(name, version)] from workspaces[""].dependencies through each package's "dependencies"; not devDependencies, not optionalPeers
56	def licence_texts(directory: Path, owner: str, licence: str, authors: list) -> tuple
57	def font_revision(path: Path) -> str
58	def collect(root: Path, build_dir: Optional[str], strict_bun: bool, sparkle_license: Optional[Path]) -> list
59	def render(entries: list) -> str
60	def main(argv=None) -> int
61	```
62	`tools/codecs/build_codecs.py`: `def leading_comment(path) -> str` (the text between a file's leading `/*` and first `*/`, blank edge lines stripped; `BuildFailed` naming the file when absent); svt-av1's `licenses` gains `("Source/Lib/Codec/vector.c", "vector.c-LICENSE")`, `_assemble` writing `leading_comment()` for an entry ending `.c`; `--print-key` prints `key(gather_inputs())` alone on stdout (exit 1 with `error: …` on `BuildFailed`).
63	
64	`tools/proof/dist_check.py` (must NOT import the generator; its own readers):
65	```
66	ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS = os.path.join("Contents", "Resources", "Acknowledgements.txt")
67	ACK_HEADER = re.compile(r"^== (crate|npm|runtime|framework|library|model|font) (\S+) (\S+) ==$", re.M)
68	FIRST_PARTY = ("framejob-core", "graphic", "framejob-mcp")
69	CODEC_STRINGS = (b"SVT-AV1 Encoder Lib", b"WebM Project VP9 Encoder")   # each encoder's own literal; survives `strip`
70	def shipped_crates() -> tuple   # (set of (name, version) | None, reason); cargo metadata as the generator runs it, own walk
71	def shipped_npm() -> tuple      # (set of (name, version) | None, reason); its own agent/bun.lock reader
72	def acknowledgements(app) -> tuple   # (ok, detail naming what is missing)
73	def codec_strings(binary) -> tuple   # (ok, detail naming each CODEC_STRINGS entry absent from the file's bytes)
74	```
75	D42 / D43: the Release / Distribution bundle's `Acknowledgements.txt` has a header for every shipped crate and npm package (name and version), each pin (`library <name> <version>`), `framework sparkle <project.yml exactVersion>`, `runtime bun <any>`, `model silero-vad <any>`, and `font <stem> <any>` for each `*.ttf` in the bundle's `Contents/Resources/Fonts/`. D36/D37 stay as they are (`nm -j` over the unstripped build products).
76	published_check: P22 = `dist_check.codec_strings` over the app's binary (NOT D37's `codec_symbols`: `xcodebuild archive` strips the symbol table), P23 = D39 (`system_loads`), P24 = D41 (`codec_licences`), P25 = D43 (`acknowledgements`); last line `published_check: <passed>/25`.
77	dist_check_mutants cases: `("acknowledgements-missing-release", ("release",), "acknowledgements-missing", {"D42"})`, `("acknowledgements-crate-dropped-dist", ("dist",), "acknowledgements-crate-dropped", {"D43"})` (the first `== crate ` header line deleted from the copy).
78	
79	## Approach
80	1. Spec §11 first. **PUB-10**: acknowledgements in every configuration at `Contents/Resources/Acknowledgements.txt`, written each build by the generator. Crates come from `cargo metadata --format-version 1 --locked --offline --filter-platform aarch64-apple-darwin` in `core/` and `mcp-proxy/` over every non-dev edge (build deps and proc macros included), first-party excluded. npm packages come from `agent/bun.lock`, each version confirmed against `agent/node_modules/<name>/package.json`. Each package gets its root licence files, else the canonical SPDX text under its declared authors; the build fails naming the package when no canonical text exists. A nested licence file must be in `NESTED` (include or exclude), or the build fails naming it. Sparkle gets its own `LICENSE` from the resolved package. Bun's `LICENSE.md` is vendored at `BUN_LICENSE_VERSION`: a different `bun --version` fails Distribution builds (`--strict-bun`) and is noted in the others. The pins' texts come from `build/codecs/licenses/` (amends CX-5 with `vector.c-LICENSE`). The VAD model and each font are included, the fonts with their OFL text. No About-panel entry (no §9 row, no guide line). Risk accepted: Bun's notice names its embedded libraries (JavaScriptCore, LGPL-2) by link, not full text, as Bun publishes it. **PUB-11**: published_check carries the encoders' rows P22–P24 and the acknowledgements' P25. P22 looks for each encoder's own string literal in the binary's bytes, because the archive strips the symbol table D37 reads. **PUB-12**: the workflow restores `build/codecs` from the Actions cache under `codecs-<build_codecs.py --print-key>`, the key computed under the "Build Codecs" step's PATH prefix, with no `restore-keys`. After Archive, whatever its outcome, a step compares `build/codecs/stamp.json`'s key with that key. A mismatch or a missing stamp is a `::warning::` naming both keys and is never saved. On a cache miss with equal keys the folder is saved, so a later failed step does not lose it. The stamp still decides reuse. setup-bun installs `BUN_LICENSE_VERSION`. Index rows and Lines cells land in the same change.
81	2. `build_codecs.py`: add `leading_comment`, the new licence entry, `--print-key`, E0 (CONTROL: a scratch `.c` excerpts exactly its header) and E1 (no leading comment raises, naming the file). Existing mutants must still fail exactly their rows. `make codecs` then rebuilds, because the script's bytes are in the key (it needs network if `build/codecs-downloads/` is empty).
82	3. Vendor `tools/licenses/bun/LICENSE.txt` (`curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oven-sh/bun/bun-v<ver>/LICENSE.md`) and `spdx/MIT.txt`; record both in `tools/licenses/PROVENANCE.md`.
83	4. The generator.
84	   - Licence files are the root files whose name starts with a `LICENCE_PREFIXES` entry. The nested scan skips `target/`, `node_modules/` and any subfolder holding its own `Cargo.toml` or `package.json`.
85	   - A path package outside `FIRST_PARTY` (tiny-skia) is `Source: vendored at graphic/vendor/tiny-skia (patched, spec §11 PR-13)`.
86	   - Sparkle's licence comes from `--sparkle-license`. Without it, the generator walks up from `$BUILD_DIR` (then `ROOT/build`) for `SourcePackages/artifacts/sparkle/Sparkle/LICENSE`, failing with every path tried.
87	   - It writes atomically (temp file + `os.replace`).
88	   - Selftest rows (no cargo, no network, scratch only):
89	     - D0 CONTROL: two renders are byte-identical.
90	     - G1: dev edges and first-party are excluded.
91	     - G2: build edges are included.
92	     - N1: the npm graph from a trailing-comma lock skips dev deps and optional peers.
93	     - L1: no licence file → the SPDX text under the authors.
94	     - L2: no canonical text → `Failed` naming the package and id.
95	     - L3: an unlisted nested licence fails, naming it.
96	     - L4: a listed include is written, an exclude is not.
97	     - T1: a repeated text becomes the "identical to" line.
98	     - F1: the font revision is read from a synthetic sfnt.
99	     - B1: a Bun mismatch fails under `--strict-bun` and is noted without it.
100	   - Mutants: `dev-edges` {G1}, `nested-unchecked` {L3}, `bun-unchecked` {B1}.
101	5. `project.yml` step: `basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false`; `set -e`; PATH `$HOME/.cargo/bin:$HOME/.bun/bin:$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:/usr/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH`; `--strict-bun` when `$CONFIGURATION` is `Distribution`; `--out "$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH/Acknowledgements.txt"`. Then the `Makefile` and `gate.py` edits.
102	6. `dist_check.py`: the readers, `CODEC_STRINGS`/`codec_strings` (reads the file's bytes, as D33's updater needle does), and D42/D43. Before relying on `CODEC_STRINGS`, confirm each literal with `grep -c -a -F` in the built Release binary. If one is absent there, choose another literal from `strings -a build/codecs/lib/<archive>` that the binary holds, and record the choice in the docstring. `dist_check_mutants.py`: a `licences()`-style copy of the file into every skeleton, and its two cases.
103	7. `published_check.py`: P22–P25 through dist_check's functions.
104	8. `publish.yml`:
105	   - After Toolchain, add step `id: pins`. It runs under `export PATH="/usr/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"`, the "Build Codecs" step's prefix (`project.yml`), so `find_cmake()` and `python3` resolve as they do in Xcode.     65	def cargo_packages(metadata: dict) -> list:
    66	    """Package dicts reachable from resolve.root over non-dev edges, FIRST_PARTY removed."""
    67	    packages = {p["id"]: p for p in metadata["packages"]}
    68	    nodes = {n["id"]: n for n in metadata["resolve"]["nodes"]}
    69	    seen, stack = set(), [metadata["resolve"]["root"]]
    70	    while stack:
    71	        current = stack.pop()
    72	        if current not in seen:
    73	            seen.add(current)
    74	            stack += [d["pkg"] for d in nodes[current].get("deps", []) if MUTANT == "dev-edges"
    75	                      or any(k.get("kind") != "dev" for k in d.get("dep_kinds", []))]
    76	    return [packages[i] for i in sorted(seen) if packages[i]["name"] not in FIRST_PARTY]

    79	def npm_packages(lock_text: str) -> list:
    80	    """[(name, version)] from workspaces[""].dependencies through each package's
    81	    "dependencies"; not devDependencies, not optionalPeers."""
    82	    lock = json.loads(re.sub(r",(\s*[}\]])", r"\1", lock_text))
    83	    entries, found = lock.get("packages", {}), {}
    84	    stack = [("", name) for name in sorted(lock["workspaces"][""].get("dependencies", {}))]
    85	    while stack:
    86	        parent, name = stack.pop()
    87	        key = f"{parent}/{name}" if parent and f"{parent}/{name}" in entries else name
    88	        if key not in entries:
    89	            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {name} is not in agent/bun.lock's packages")
    90	        if key in found:
    91	            continue
    92	        entry = entries[key]
    93	        found[key] = (name, entry[0].rsplit("@", 1)[1])
    94	        meta = entry[2] if len(entry) > 2 and isinstance(entry[2], dict) else {}
    95	        stack += [(key, dep) for dep in sorted(meta.get("dependencies", {}))]
    96	    return sorted(set(found.values()))

    99	def licence_texts(directory: Path, owner: str, licence: str, authors: list) -> tuple:
   100	    """((label, text), ...): the root licence files, else the canonical SPDX texts under the
   101	    authors; then each nested licence file NESTED includes."""
   102	    directory = Path(directory)
   103	    texts = [(p.name, read(p)) for p in sorted(directory.iterdir())
   104	             if p.is_file() and p.name.upper().startswith(LICENCE_PREFIXES)]
   105	    if not texts:
   106	        if not licence:
   107	            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {owner} ships no licence file and declares none")
   108	        holders = ", ".join(authors) if authors else f"the {owner} authors"
   109	        ids = [t for t in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9.+-]+", licence) if t not in ("AND", "OR", "WITH")]
   110	        if " AND " not in licence and "(" not in licence:  # alternatives: the first with a text
   111	            ids = [i for i in ids if (HERE / "spdx" / f"{i}.txt").is_file()][:1] or ids
   112	        for spdx in ids:
   113	            canonical = HERE / "spdx" / f"{spdx}.txt"
   114	            if not canonical.is_file():
   115	                raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {owner} ships no licence file and there is no "
   116	                             f"canonical text for {spdx} (tools/licenses/spdx/{spdx}.txt)")
   117	            texts.append((f"{spdx} (the SPDX text; {owner} ships no licence file)",
   118	                          f"Copyright (c) {holders}\n\n{read(canonical)}"))
   119	    for folder, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):
   120	        here = Path(folder)
   121	        dirs[:] = sorted(d for d in dirs if d not in ("target", "node_modules")
   122	                         and not (here / d / "Cargo.toml").exists()
   123	                         and not (here / d / "package.json").exists())
   124	        for name in sorted(files) if here != directory else ():
   125	            relative = (here / name).relative_to(directory).as_posix()
   126	            listed = NESTED.get((owner, relative))
   127	            licence_file = name.upper().startswith(LICENCE_PREFIXES)
   128	            if licence_file and listed is None and MUTANT != "nested-unchecked":
   129	                raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {owner}'s nested licence file {relative} is "
   130	                             "not in NESTED (tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py); list it")
   131	            if licence_file and listed:
   132	                texts.append((relative, read(here / name)))
   133	    return tuple(texts)

   136	def font_revision(path: Path) -> str:
   137	    """The `head` table's fontRevision (16.16 fixed), to three decimals."""
   138	    data = Path(path).read_bytes()
   139	    count = struct.unpack(">H", data[4:6])[0] if len(data) >= 12 else 0
   140	    for index in range(count):
   141	        tag, _, offset, _ = struct.unpack(">4sIII", data[12 + 16 * index:28 + 16 * index])
   142	        if tag == b"head":
   143	            return f"{struct.unpack('>i', data[offset + 4:offset + 8])[0] / 65536:.3f}"
   144	    raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {path} has no sfnt head table")

   147	def bun_check(found, strict):
   148	    """None when `found` is BUN_LICENSE_VERSION; else Failed under `strict`, or the note."""
   149	    if found == BUN_LICENSE_VERSION:
   150	        return None
   151	    message = (f"bun --version is {found or '(no bun found)'}, but the vendored licence is Bun "
   152	               f"{BUN_LICENSE_VERSION}'s; re-vendor it (tools/licenses/PROVENANCE.md)")
   153	    if strict and MUTANT != "bun-unchecked":
   154	        raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {message}")
   155	    return message

   158	def _crates(root):
   159	    found = {}
   160	    for folder in CARGO_ROOTS:
   161	        argv = ["cargo", "metadata", "--format-version", "1", "--locked", "--offline",
   162	                "--filter-platform", TARGET]
   163	        done = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=str(root / folder), capture_output=True, text=True)
   164	        if done.returncode != 0:
   165	            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {' '.join(argv)} in {folder}/ exited "
   166	                         f"{done.returncode}: {done.stderr.strip()[-300:]}")
   167	        found.update((p["id"], p) for p in cargo_packages(json.loads(done.stdout)))
   168	    entries = []
   169	    for p in sorted(found.values(), key=lambda p: (p["name"], p["version"])):
   170	        directory = Path(p["manifest_path"]).parent
   171	        source = "crates.io" if p.get("source") == CRATES_IO else p.get("source")
   172	        if source is None:
   173	            patched = f" (patched, {PATCHED[p['name']]})" if p["name"] in PATCHED else ""
   174	            source = f"vendored at {os.path.relpath(directory, root)}{patched}"
   175	        licence = p.get("license") or ""
   176	        texts = licence_texts(directory, p["name"], licence, p.get("authors") or [])
   177	        entries.append(Entry("crate", p["name"], p["version"], licence or "(none declared)",
   178	                             source, texts))
   179	    return entries

   182	def _npm(root):
   183	    entries = []
   184	    for name, version in npm_packages(read(root / "agent" / "bun.lock")):
   185	        directory = root / "agent" / "node_modules" / name
   186	        try:
   187	            manifest = json.loads(read(directory / "package.json"))
   188	        except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
   189	            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: agent/node_modules/{name}/package.json: {error}")
   190	        if manifest.get("version") != version:
   191	            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: agent/bun.lock pins {name} {version}, but "
   192	                         f"node_modules holds {manifest.get('version')} (run bun install)")
   193	        licence, author = manifest.get("license") or "", manifest.get("author")
   194	        licence = licence.get("type", "") if isinstance(licence, dict) else licence
   195	        author = author.get("name") if isinstance(author, dict) else author
   196	        texts = licence_texts(directory, name, licence, [author] if author else [])
   197	        entries.append(Entry("npm", name, version, licence or "(none declared)", "npm", texts))
   198	    return sorted(entries, key=lambda e: e.name)

   201	def _sparkle(root, build_dir, sparkle_license):
   202	    if sparkle_license is None:
   203	        starts = [Path(build_dir)] if build_dir else []
   204	        tried = [folder / SPARKLE_LICENSE for start in starts for folder in [start, *start.parents]]
   205	        tried.append(root / "build" / SPARKLE_LICENSE)
   206	        sparkle_license = next((path for path in tried if path.is_file()), None)
   207	        if sparkle_license is None:
   208	            raise Failed("acknowledgements: Sparkle's LICENSE is in none of "
   209	                         + ", ".join(map(str, tried)))
   210	    state_path = Path(sparkle_license).parents[3] / "workspace-state.json"

   213	                   for d in json.loads(read(state_path))["object"]["dependencies"]
   214	                   if d["packageRef"]["identity"] == "sparkle"][0]
   215	    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, IndexError, TypeError) as error:
   216	        raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: no resolved sparkle version in {state_path}: {error!r}")
   217	    return Entry("framework", "sparkle", version, "MIT (with the notices its LICENSE lists)",
   218	                 "https://github.com/sparkle-project/Sparkle", (("LICENSE", read(sparkle_license)),))

   222	            sparkle_license: Optional[Path]) -> list:
   223	    root = Path(root)

   225	    bun = shutil.which("bun")

   227	    note = bun_check(done.stdout.strip() if done and done.returncode == 0 else None, strict_bun)
   228	    if note:

   230	    entries.append(Entry(
   231	        "runtime", "bun", BUN_LICENSE_VERSION,
   232	        "MIT; it embeds JavaScriptCore and WebKit (LGPL-2) and the libraries its notice lists",
   233	        f"https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/tree/bun-v{BUN_LICENSE_VERSION}",
   234	        ((("note", note),) if note else ()) + (("LICENSE.md", read(HERE / "bun/LICENSE.txt")),)))
   235	    entries.append(_sparkle(root, build_dir, sparkle_license))
   236	    for pin in build_codecs.PINS:
   237	        paths = [root / "build/codecs/licenses" / pin.name / name for _, name in pin.licenses]
   238	        entries.append(Entry("library", pin.name, pin.version, LIBRARY_LICENCES[pin.name],
   239	                             pin.url, tuple((path.name, read(path)) for path in paths)))
   240	    models = root / "app/Resources/Models"
   241	    tag = re.search(r"tag `v([^`]+)`", read(models / "PROVENANCE.md"))
   242	    if tag is None:
   243	        raise Failed("acknowledgements: no tag `vX` in app/Resources/Models/PROVENANCE.md")
   244	    entries.append(Entry("model", "silero-vad", tag.group(1), "MIT",
   245	                         "https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad",
   246	                         (("LICENSE", read(models / "LICENSE")),)))
   247	    fonts = root / "app/Resources/Fonts"
   248	    for font in sorted(fonts.glob("*.ttf"), key=lambda p: p.stem):
   249	        ofl = fonts / f"OFL-{font.stem.split('-')[0]}.txt"
   250	        if not ofl.is_file():
   251	            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {font.name} has no {ofl.name} beside it")
   252	        entries.append(Entry("font", font.stem, font_revision(font), "OFL-1.1",
   253	                             "vendored at app/Resources/Fonts", ((ofl.name, read(ofl)),)))

   257	def render(entries: list) -> str:
   258	    out, first = ["Frame Job — third-party software notices", "Generated at build time by "
   259	                  "tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py; do not edit.", PREAMBLE, ""], {}
   260	    for e in entries:
   261	        out += [f"== {e.kind} {e.name} {e.version} ==", f"Licence: {e.licence}",
   262	                f"Source: {e.source}"]
   263	        for label, text in e.texts:
   264	            out.append(f"--- {label} ---")
   265	            if text in first:
   266	                out.append(f"(identical to {first[text]}, above)")
   267	            else:
   268	                first[text] = f"{e.kind} {e.name} {e.version}'s {label}"
   269	                out.append(text.rstrip("\n"))
   270	        out.append("")
   271	    return "\n".join(out)

   274	def selftest(mutant=None):
   275	    """No cargo, no network, scratch only."""
   276	    global MUTANT
   277	    MUTANT, results = mutant, []
   278	
   279	    def row(name, ok, detail):
   280	        results.append((name, bool(ok)))
   281	        print(f"  {'ok  ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail}", flush=True)
   282	
   283	    def failure(call):
   284	        try:
   285	            call()
   286	        except Failed as error:
   287	            return str(error)
   288	
   289	    def put(path, text):
   290	        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   291	        path.write_text(text)
   292	
   293	    scratch = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="acknowledgements-selftest-"))
   294	    try:
   295	        entries = [Entry("crate", "a", "1.0", "MIT", "crates.io", (("LICENSE", "text a\n"),)),
   296	                   Entry("crate", "b", "2.0", "MIT", "crates.io", (("LICENSE", "text a\n"),)),
   297	                   Entry("font", "F-Bold", "1.500", "OFL-1.1", "x", (("OFL-F.txt", "ofl\n"),))]
   298	        one, two = render(entries), render(list(entries))
   299	        row("D0", one.encode() == two.encode(),
   300	            f"CONTROL: two renders are byte-identical ({len(one)} characters)")
   301	        row("T1", "(identical to crate a 1.0's LICENSE, above)" in one
   302	            and one.count("\ntext a\n") == 1, "a repeated text becomes the 'identical to' line")
   303	        def node(i, *deps):
   304	            return {"id": i, "deps": [{"pkg": d, "dep_kinds": [{"kind": k}]} for d, k in deps]}
   305	        ids = ("framejob-core", "graphic", "lib", "devonly", "buildonly", "devdeep")
   306	        metadata = {"packages": [{"id": i, "name": i, "version": "1"} for i in ids],
   307	                    "resolve": {"root": "framejob-core", "nodes": [
   308	                        node("framejob-core", ("graphic", None), ("devonly", "dev"),
   309	                             ("buildonly", "build")),
   310	                        node("graphic", ("lib", None)), node("lib"),
   311	                        node("devonly", ("devdeep", None)), node("buildonly"), node("devdeep")]}}
   312	        names = {p["name"] for p in cargo_packages(metadata)}
   313	        row("G1", not names & {"devonly", "devdeep", *FIRST_PARTY} and "lib" in names,
   314	            f"dev edges and first-party are excluded: {sorted(names)}")
   315	        row("G2", "buildonly" in names, f"build edges are included: {sorted(names)}")
   316	        lock = """{ "workspaces": { "": { "dependencies": { "a": "^1", }, "devDependencies": {
   317	    "dev": "^1", }, }, }, "packages": { "a": ["a@1.2.0", "", { "dependencies": { "b": "^2", },
   318	    "peerDependencies": { "p": "^1" }, "optionalPeers": ["p"], }, "sha512-x"], "b": ["b@2.0.1",
   319	    "", {}, "y"], "dev": ["dev@1.0.0", "", {}, "z"], "p": ["p@1.0.0", "", {}, "w"], } }"""
   320	        got = npm_packages(lock)
   321	        row("N1", got == [("a", "1.2.0"), ("b", "2.0.1")],
   322	            f"a trailing-comma lock skips dev deps and optional peers: {got}")
   323	        (scratch / "bare").mkdir()
   324	        texts = licence_texts(scratch / "bare", "bare", "MIT", ["Ann <ann@example.com>"])
   325	        row("L1", len(texts) == 1 and texts[0][1].startswith("Copyright (c) Ann <ann@example")
   326	            and "Permission is hereby granted" in texts[0][1],
   327	            f"no licence file gives the SPDX text under the authors: {[t[0] for t in texts]}")
   328	        why = failure(lambda: licence_texts(scratch / "bare", "bare", "Foo-1.0", []))
   329	        row("L2", why is not None and "bare" in why and "Foo-1.0" in why,
   330	            f"no canonical text fails naming the package and id: {why}")
   331	        for path in ("nested/LICENSE", "nested/sub/COPYING"):
   332	            put(scratch / path, f"{path}\n")
   333	        why = failure(lambda: licence_texts(scratch / "nested", "nested", "MIT", []))
   334	        row("L3", why is not None and "sub/COPYING" in why,
   335	            f"an unlisted nested licence fails, naming it: {why}")
   336	        listed = scratch / "rquickjs-sys"
   337	        for path in ("quickjs/LICENSE", "vendor/wasi-libc/NOTICE.md", "crate/Cargo.toml",
   338	                     "crate/LICENSE"):
   339	            put(listed / path, f"{path}\n")
   340	        labels = [label for label, _ in licence_texts(listed, "rquickjs-sys", "MIT", [])]
   341	        row("L4", "quickjs/LICENSE" in labels and "vendor/wasi-libc/NOTICE.md" not in labels
   342	            and "crate/LICENSE" not in labels,
   343	            f"a listed include is written, an exclude is not: {labels}")
   344	        head = struct.pack(">IIiI", 0x00010000, 0x00018000, 0, 0x5F0F3CF5)
   345	        sfnt = struct.pack(">IHHHH4sIII", 0x00010000, 1, 16, 0, 0, b"head", 0, 28, len(head))
   346	        (scratch / "font.ttf").write_bytes(sfnt + head)
   347	        got = font_revision(scratch / "font.ttf")
   348	        row("F1", got == "1.500", f"the font revision is read from a synthetic sfnt: {got}")
   349	        other = "0.0.1" if BUN_LICENSE_VERSION != "0.0.1" else "0.0.2"
   350	        why, note = failure(lambda: bun_check(other, True)), bun_check(other, False)
   351	        row("B1", why is not None and other in why and note is not None
   352	            and BUN_LICENSE_VERSION in note and bun_check(BUN_LICENSE_VERSION, True) is None,
   353	            f"a Bun mismatch fails under --strict-bun ({why}) and is noted without it")
   354	    finally:
   355	        shutil.rmtree(scratch, ignore_errors=True)
   356	
   357	    failed = {name for name, ok in results if not ok}
   358	    print(f"{len(results) - len(failed)}/{len(results)} rows pass")
   359	    ok = failed == EXPECTED[mutant] if mutant else not failed
   360	    print(f"MUTANT {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}: {mutant} failed {sorted(failed)}, expected "
   361	          f"{sorted(EXPECTED[mutant])}" if mutant else "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
   362	    return 0 if ok else 1

   365	def main(argv=None) -> int:
   366	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="the acknowledgements (#376, spec §11 PUB-10)")
   367	    parser.add_argument("--out", help="where to write Acknowledgements.txt")
   368	    parser.add_argument("--strict-bun", action="store_true",
   369	                        help="fail when bun --version is not BUN_LICENSE_VERSION (Distribution)")
   370	    parser.add_argument("--sparkle-license", help="Sparkle's LICENSE, else found from $BUILD_DIR")
   371	    parser.add_argument("--print-bun-version", action="store_true", help="for setup-bun")
   372	    parser.add_argument("--selftest", action="store_true", help="D0 T1 G1 G2 N1 L1–L4 F1 B1")
   373	    parser.add_argument("--mutant", choices=sorted(EXPECTED))
   374	    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
   375	    if args.selftest or args.mutant:
   376	        return selftest(args.mutant)
   377	    if args.print_bun_version:
   378	        return print(BUN_LICENSE_VERSION) or 0
   379	    if not args.out:
   380	        parser.error("--out is required")
   381	    try:
   382	        sparkle = Path(args.sparkle_license) if args.sparkle_license else None
   383	        entries = collect(ROOT, os.environ.get("BUILD_DIR"), args.strict_bun, sparkle)

          # fetches the pinned tarballs and builds them with cmake, which a
          # runner image may or may not carry; the system perl is enough.

--- a/docs/developing.md
+++ b/docs/developing.md
-| `make test` | `make codecs` first, then the Rust tests of `core/`, `graphic/` and `mcp-proxy/`, then the scripted checks that need no app: the assistant's agent lane and prompt texts, the price function and the proofs' spend budgets (no network), the menu inventory and spec index against the tree, the self-tests of the encoder build, the probe build, app-choice, gate and appcast scripts, the de
+| `make test` | `make codecs` first, then the Rust tests of `core/`, `graphic/` and `mcp-proxy/`, then the scripted checks that need no app: the assistant's agent lane and prompt texts, the price function and the proofs' spend budgets (no network), the menu inventory and spec index against the tree, the self-tests of the encoder build, the acknowledgements' generator, the probe build, app-choice,
+tools/licenses/  acknowledgements.py (every build's third-party notices,
+                 Contents/Resources/Acknowledgements.txt), the vendored texts
+                 it needs (bun/LICENSE.txt, spdx/MIT.txt) and PROVENANCE.md.
+**The encoders' cache (spec §11 PUB-12).** A "Read the pins" step computes
+`tools/codecs/build_codecs.py --print-key` under the "Build Codecs" step's
+PATH prefix (`/usr/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin`), so cmake and
+`python3` resolve as they do inside Xcode, and `build/codecs` is restored from
+the Actions cache under `codecs-<key>`, with no `restore-keys`. After the
+Archive, whatever its outcome, a step compares `build/codecs/stamp.json`'s key
+with that key: a missing stamp or another key is a `::warning::` naming both,
+and the folder is not saved; on a cache miss with equal keys it is saved, so a
+later failed step does not lose the build. The stamp, not the cache, decides
+whether Build Codecs reuses the folder, so a stale cache can never ship. A
+change to the script, the pins, cmake or the SDK changes the key and builds
+the encoders again once.
+
+**The acknowledgements (spec §11 PUB-10, PUB-11).** Every build writes
+`Contents/Resources/Acknowledgements.txt` (project.yml's "Write
+Acknowledgements", `tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py`): each shipped crate
+(`cargo metadata` over every non-dev edge of `core/` and `mcp-proxy/`), each npm
+package the helper bundles (`agent/bun.lock`), Bun, Sparkle, the encoders, the
+voice-activity model and each font, each with its full licence text. A crate
+or package with no licence file gets the canonical SPDX text from
+`tools/licenses/spdx/` under its authors, and the build fails naming it when
+that text is not vendored; a licence file nested in a package must be listed
+in the generator's `NESTED`, or the build fails naming it. `make dist`'s
+`dist_check.py` D42/D43 and the workflow's `published_check.py` P25 hold the
+file to every shipped component; P22–P24 hold the encoders (each one's own
+string in the binary, which the archive's strip keeps; the load commands; the
+licence texts).
+
+**The Bun pin.** The helper is compiled by Bun, whose own licence
+(`tools/licenses/bun/LICENSE.txt`) is vendored at `BUN_LICENSE_VERSION` in
+`acknowledgements.py`. A Distribution build whose `bun --version` differs
+fails, and Debug and Release builds write a note into the file instead, so the
+workflow's setup-bun installs exactly that version
+(`acknowledgements.py --print-bun-version`). After upgrading Bun locally,
+re-vendor its licence as `tools/licenses/PROVENANCE.md` says.
+
+What only a real publish shows: a cache save on its first run, and on the
+second a hit, `codecs: reused <key>` in the Archive's log and no stamp
+warning; the Developer ID export keeping `Acknowledgements.txt` (P25 over the
+exported app); and setup-bun installing the pinned Bun.
+
# Vendored licence texts — provenance

`tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py` (spec §11 PUB-10) writes every build's
`Contents/Resources/Acknowledgements.txt`. Two texts it needs are not in any lockfile or
package, so they are vendored here. Both are `.txt`, never `.md`: `tools/proof/gate.py`
counts no `*.md` under `tools/licenses/` as an input of the `app` step.

| File | What | Source | SHA-256 | Fetched |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bun/LICENSE.txt` | Bun's `LICENSE.md`, verbatim (no trailing newline, as published) | <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oven-sh/bun/bun-v1.3.6/LICENSE.md>, tag `bun-v1.3.6` | `4cf82fd717b2b34dfabf6087c35fcffd28386054f1791d2e6ecfdfcafe0131a8` | 2026-10-28 |
| `spdx/MIT.txt` | The SPDX MIT text with its `Copyright (c) <year> <copyright holders>` line and the blank line after it removed; the generator writes a package's declared authors above it | <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/f715b3660bb164c3d0b81cba9ce94e3c558c4048/text/MIT.txt>, `spdx/license-list-data` commit `f715b3660bb164c3d0b81cba9ce94e3c558c4048` (the upstream file's SHA-256 `b05785f9f18e6716bab63424b11454513b9943a222595b70411009202fc592b5`) | `9645fb6e878aebd5e959be648a71973a108d4aa0d18eee478d0579066ad99958` | 2026-10-28 |

`spdx/<id>.txt` is the canonical text of one SPDX id, used for a package that ships no
licence file of its own. Only MIT is needed today (`rquickjs-core`, `rquickjs-sys`,
`standardwebhooks`); a package declaring an id with no file here fails the build, naming
the package and the id, and the fix is to vendor that id's text the same way.

## Re-vendoring Bun's licence

`BUN_LICENSE_VERSION` in `acknowledgements.py` is the Bun this text came from. The publish
workflow installs exactly that Bun (`oven-sh/setup-bun`'s `bun-version`, read with
`acknowledgements.py --print-bun-version`, spec §11 PUB-12), and a Distribution build whose
`bun --version` differs fails (`--strict-bun`); Debug and Release write a note instead. After
upgrading Bun:

```sh
V="$(bun --version)"
curl -fsSL -o tools/licenses/bun/LICENSE.txt \
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oven-sh/bun/bun-v$V/LICENSE.md"
shasum -a 256 tools/licenses/bun/LICENSE.txt
```

then set `BUN_LICENSE_VERSION` to `$V`, and update the row above (tag, SHA-256, date).

`04-checks.txt` covers every targeted and full command in the spec's Verification section, and each result matches "Passing means". The archive line was run too: published_check scored 25/25 on the stripped app, and `nm` found 0 copies of the symbol. Nothing was re-run.

## Findings

### 1 — should-fix
- **Where:** tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py:87 (and :185; tools/proof/dist_check.py:758)
- **What:** `npm_packages` resolves a nested `parent/name` lock key, but `_npm` then reads the hoisted `agent/node_modules/<name>/package.json`. A nested version will therefore always fail the build with the misleading "run bun install". dist_check's `shipped_npm` looks up only `packages[name]`, so it would also expect the hoisted version, not the nested one the generator writes.
- **Fix:** For a nested key, have `_npm` read `agent/node_modules/<parent>/node_modules/<name>`, and give `shipped_npm` the same nested-key lookup. Alternatively, drop the nested-key branch and fail clearly, naming the nested entry as unsupported.

### 2 — nit
- **Where:** tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py:386
- **What:** `mkstemp` creates the temporary file inside the bundle's Resources folder, and nothing removes it if writing fails. The build then exits 1 and leaves a stray `.acknowledgements-*` file that the next build seals into the bundle.
- **Fix:** Wrap the write and `os.replace` in `try`/`except` (or `finally`), unlinking `temporary` when the replace has not happened.

### 3 — nit
- **Where:** tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py:18
- **What:** Squeezing the file under 400 lines made it harder to read: nine imports on one `# noqa: E401` line, a selftest with no blank lines, and `return print(...) or 0` at :378.
- **Fix:** Use one import per line and a plain `print(...); return 0`. If that pushes the file past the cap, move the selftest into its own module.
